original_test_intent: Have a qualified operator run the owner-approved Elden Ring scenario on the physical Windows GPU/display path and directly assess rendering stability and interactive response.
original_method: Identify the approved game build, save/scene, actions, display/GPU path and settings, capture baseline, have the operator play the bounded scenario while observing pixels and controls, record video/notes and telemetry, stop on artifact/crash/hang/thermal fault and restore the game/display session.
manual_activity: A qualified operator launches and plays the approved Elden Ring build/save/scene on the physical display, performs the defined actions, judges rendering and response, records evidence and restores the session; the agent only packages corroborating telemetry.
required_inputs: Exact Windows SUT/image and GPU/driver identity
Licensed owner-approved Elden Ring build and account/save
Pinned scene, route or encounter and starting state
Required input actions and 20-minute workload boundary
Display path, resolution, refresh, HDR and graphics settings
Local game/display recovery path and final state
safety_requirements: Do not infer a resolution matrix absent from source
Do not run with an unapproved game account/save or scene
Use a dedicated approved Windows session
Stop on crash, hang, no signal, corruption, flicker, edge artifact or control loss
Do not treat telemetry or a remote screenshot as physical scanout/gameplay proof
Restore approved display and session state
agent_execution_scope: Collect operator video/photos and responsiveness observations
Optionally capture read-only GPU/Windows/BMC telemetry and events
Package evidence without playing or deciding the visual verdict
engineer_actions: Provide licensed game/session and qualified operator
Perform/supervise local gameplay and visual judgment

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Its refusal to claim agent execution is correct because physical pixels and interactive controls require a local operator. The added resolution-change statement is not sourced and is excluded unless separately approved.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: No agent-executed game command. Operator follows the approved Elden Ring scenario/action script on the physical display; read-only health and event collection only corroborate the manual result.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Elden Ring, physical display/game observation, 15 attended and 20 machine minutes remain. No resolution list, benchmark route or pass threshold is invented.

modernized_recommendation.status: MANUAL ELDEN RING SCENE, INPUT AND VISUAL-RESPONSE MATRIX
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: For the approved scene and settings, record launch/start state, prescribed movement/combat/camera actions, frame presentation/artifacts, control response, crash/hang status, thermal/driver telemetry and final recovery.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Turns generic 'display game' into an owner-approved manual scenario and evidence timeline without inventing benchmark or resolution coverage.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Remote process status or captured framebuffer cannot prove monitor scanout, controller response, subjective edge artifacts or playability; 3DMark also does not cover game-specific engine behavior.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A game update, save state, anti-cheat/account prompt or shader compilation can change behavior; settings and starting state must be pinned for reproducibility.

project_override_considerations: Approve Elden Ring version/license/account/save/scene, action timeline, graphics/display settings, visual and responsiveness boundaries, thermal/driver stops, evidence and recovery before manual execution; retain Master TBD.
expected_evidence: Approved settings/actions/duration, operator and recovery record
Timestamped physical-display video/photos plus control-response observations
Game crash/hang, GPU thermal/power/driver and Windows/BMC event corroboration
Any abort/recovery and restored final session/display state

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items and Procedure consistently request Elden Ring display/game observation. Criteria is incomplete but does not contradict the purpose; DeepSeek's extra resolution-change text is not Master authority.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The decisive activity—local interactive gameplay and physical visual judgment—is understandable. Build/scene/settings and acceptance are owner inputs needed before execution, but the review classification remains MANUAL ONLY rather than irreducibly BLOCKED.

review_improvement: Preserves DeepSeek's correct manual boundary, removes its unsupported resolution-change assumption and adds game-specific scene, interaction, display, health, evidence and recovery controls.
independent_technical_reasoning: Elden Ring exercises its own renderer, shaders, streaming and input loop. A benchmark or remote process check cannot establish that a pinned scene renders on the actual monitor or responds to local input without artifacts. Only an operator observing both pixels and controls can supply the primary evidence, while telemetry explains but cannot replace that judgment.
